hypothesis: Admitted affine reductions that exceed the full-trip scratch ceiling can be split with bounded original-control chunks. Keep the accepted canonical N-base scheduler; otherwise stop each producer on its original exit or a local completed ordinal reaching capacity, carry the actual next IV and simultaneous retained backedges, consume initialized contributions, then resume only if the original decision continues. This covers nonzero/runtime starts, constant nonunit/descending steps, swapped/current operands, relational and reversed-equality polarity without requiring an exact trip count, vectorizable original loop, pressure threshold or profitability model.
semantics: Every prior affine-recognition, finite representable bound, branch-only acyclic CFG, closed reduction-use/dependence, effect, participation and dominating live-out proof remains. There are no new rejection bypasses except replacing canonical-only chunk admission. For an entered chunk j its local ordinal starts at zero. The acyclic CFG reaches the latch exactly once per original iteration, incrementing the completed ordinal exactly once; stop at original termination or C completed iterations. Thus 1<=K<=C and store indices for unconditional contributions are 0..K-1. Compact P starts at zero separately, stores only on the original terminal participation edge at old P, and retains P on every bypass. It satisfies 0<=P<=K<=C and preserves participating order without evaluating inactive operations or adding zero FP updates. Original IV operations, comparison operands/predicate and backedge polarity remain in the fallback. Dedicated producer-exit PHIs forward original continuation, actual next IV, actual completed ordinal and simultaneous saved retained-state backedges. Chunk-entry IV comes from the original start or the actual next IV; no endpoint arithmetic or equality witness determines a chunk length. The original decision is read again only after consumption to choose resume/final exit, including empty compact chunks. The consumer bound is the actual completed count (unconditional) or actual participating count (compact). A freeze of this private proven nonpoison count makes the boundary opaque to downstream SCEV, preventing LV from reconstructing original affine termination; freeze has no semantic change on this defined count. IV/state/live-out forwarding never consumes possible poison merely to forward it. Producer current/next/state and contribution exports retain their distinct actual final-iteration values. Integer operations and FP operand order/flags are cloned unchanged in the consumer. Strict ordinary FP and explicitly enabled fission FP reordering are distinct matrix rows, with no fast-math, errno or fenv assumptions. LoopInfo nesting/membership, SE invalidation, DT rebuilding, dedicated exits, recursive LCSSA, original-source selection attribution and independent stage VF metadata remain. The new executable matrix uses exact original definitions, actual transformed scalar/vector-tail code and an independent nonchunked C oracle walking modular control with sign-bit-based signed ordering. Runtime probes independently check original continuation, current/next IV, current/next coupled integer/FP state, local ordinal, capacity, initialized scratch addresses/values, participant order, completed/participating counts, full/partial/empty chunks and exact vector/scalar lane visits before resumption; all output/live-out/input/canary bytes are compared including aliases. Static certificates check complete instructions, PHI predecessor sets, branch polarity, scratch indexing, count provenance, simultaneous carries, final exports and scalar/tail/EVL consumer control/results. Certificate mutations are constructed nonidentically outside rejection handling and must be rejected.
costs: The fallback uses the existing monotone padded-capacity binary search (at most 64 iterations over unique contribution streams) and the existing finite-count/DAG/effect/use/export analyses. It adds no new analysis, SCEV expansion, runtime versioning, entry guard, profitability threshold or unbounded storage. Instead of per-chunk N-base/sub/min/select/base+count arithmetic it adds an actual-IV outer PHI, dedicated-exit continuation/next-IV/completed-count PHIs, the local ordinal equality test combined with original continuation, polarity-preserving boolean inversion when needed, and one private-count freeze. Retained-state and reduction carry machinery is shared. Scratch for the new i32/double streams is alignTo(4*C,8)+8*C: C=1/8/9/16 reserves 16/96/112/192 bytes with 4/0/4/0 padding. Ceilings16/111/112/192 select these capacities; 15 cannot fit one padded slot. One i32 stream serves both operand-order reductions. Logical traffic is 12 bytes stored plus 12 loaded per completed unconditional iteration or participating compact iteration; nonparticipants have no scratch traffic. There are no input rereads, duplicated producer instructions or contribution recomputation. Original input load/condition guards remain. Scalar/vector/tail/EVL consumer controls and compact empty guards are inherited. Validation-only certificates and probes add fixture-scoped regex/PHI checks and bounded trace arrays of 66 entries, without production solver machinery. Physical stack layout, machine traffic, spills, target register pressure and speedup are unmeasured.
limitations: The worker ran no compiler, build, opt/llc, lit, unit/executable checker, host compilation, try.sh or benchmark evaluation. Only source/immutable-record inspection, Python syntax parsing, JSON parsing and Git diff/whitespace review were performed. All current-task build/test/execution outcomes remain pending harness validation. Finite representable count bounds, constant nonzero affine steps, admitted acyclic CFG/effect/use/participation/live-out shapes remain mandatory. Truly unavailable bounds, completed-counter overflow, incompatible participation, feedback into moved state, unsafe effects and unsupported CFG remain rejected. Ordinary strictfp/constrained FP remain rejected. The new narrow i8 case executes scalar consumers; its vector-policy EVL code generation is separately covered by the IR RUN line, without claiming narrow vector execution. New executable inputs use finite dyadic FP values, signed-zero seeds and large rounding-sensitive seeds; inherited NaN/Inf and poison families remain required. Certificates are intentionally fixture-scoped and future legal LV layouts may require explicit cases. Fixed-vscale host execution is not RVV target execution; uninstrumented RVV machine verification/EVL generation is not a speedup measurement. No d2 integration, corpus rewrite or new measured original-target outcome is claimed.
